name: Git Helper
description: Optional git integration for git-backed workspaces: status, stage-all, commit and recent history. Disabled by default.
author: Excalibur (first-party)

panels.title: Git Helper
panels.body: If your workspace is a git repository, the **Git** panel shows status and lets you commit exports. Operations run via `git` with no shell interpolation and are scoped to the workspace.
